title: Tarbela: three radar views across the season
headline: Follow Tarbela Reservoir, Pakistan across 3 real radar observations
introduction: Three compatible NISAR frequency-A HHHH observations show the reservoir landscape on 25 June, 19 July and 12 August 2026. The saved calibrated August dB raster is restored to linear power before common-grid resampling, so all three frames use the same processing order.
conclusion: Compare the shoreline and neighboring terrain through the actual acquisition dates. Radar response does not measure stored water volume or establish a flood. Wind, vegetation, roughness and geometry can influence brightness.

references.title: Dawn: Tarbela level rose from 1,504 ft to 1,537 ft (1 Aug 2026)
PMD Flood Forecasting Division daily bulletin, 30 Aug 2026

method: NISAR, consistent polarization and orbit per story. Source calibrated power converted using 10*log10 where necessary; existing dB sources are not converted again. Bilinear alignment to the first grid, invalid/nonpositive power masked, fixed viridis −30 to +5 dB display. Statistics are radar response, not classified flood area.
